snippet.title: Kill the Thing   Trailer
snippet.description: Kill The Thing is a challenging turn-based tactical RPG. Keep the corruption under control while searching for its origin. Undertake missions across four distinct regions, targeting key resources, upgrading your base, and building your roster of heroes. For the final confrontation.
